categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Dowstone Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: carbon materials, lithium battery materials, ceramic materials, and strategic resources. The carbon materials segment focuses on carbon nanotube conductive agents, graphene conductive agents, graphite and silicon-carbon anode materials. The lithium battery materials segment produces ternary precursors and cobalt salts for lithium-ion battery cathodes. The ceramic materials segment manufactures ceramic inks and glazes for the building ceramics industry. The strategic resources segment involves cobalt and copper mining and refining in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced wet chemical refining technology for lithium battery materials and has developed proprietary technologies in single-wall carbon nanotube production using catalytic chemical vapor deposition (CCVD). It has a complete supply chain for conductive agents including catalysts, powders, and slurry. The ceramic materials segment utilizes micro-nano manufacturing, ultra-dispersion, inkjet printing, and encapsulation technologies. The strategic resources segment uses mature wet copper refining processes. The company also integrates AI-driven R&D and explores AI chip development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as BYD, CATL, and other domestic and international battery producers. The lithium battery materials serve electric vehicle, consumer electronics, and energy storage markets globally. Ceramic materials are sold to major domestic building ceramics companies and exported to Southeast Asia, Africa, and Europe. Strategic resources products are sold to international companies like TRAXYS and SAMSUNG. The company targets both domestic and overseas markets, with overseas sales accounting for over 65% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangdong, Anhui, Jiangxi, Shandong, and Gansu provinces. It has overseas operations in Hong Kong, Indonesia, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Its products are sold domestically and exported to Japan, South Korea, Europe, Southeast Asia, Africa, and the Americas. The company is expanding its international footprint, especially in lithium battery materials and carbon materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dowstone operates across multiple points in the supply chain: upstream mining and refining of cobalt and copper in Congo; midstream production of lithium battery precursors, cobalt salts, and carbon nanotube conductive agents; and downstream supply of ceramic materials to building ceramics manufacturers. It integrates raw material procurement, production, and direct sales, positioning itself as a comprehensive materials supplier in the lithium-ion battery and ceramics industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in solid-state battery materials, including single-wall carbon nanotubes, silicon-carbon anodes, solid and semi-solid electrolytes, and lithium metal anodes. It invests heavily in R&D with national-level technology centers and collaborates with top universities. AI-driven research and AI chip development are strategic new directions. The company aims to become a leading provider of full-material solutions for solid-state batteries and expands its international R&D and market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products including carbon materials (conductive agents and anode materials), lithium battery materials (ternary precursors and cobalt salts), ceramic materials (inks and glazes), and strategic resource products (cathode copper and cobalt intermediates). The company operates on a make-to-order basis with long-term contracts, especially in lithium battery materials, and exports a significant portion of its products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In carbon materials, competitors include TianNai Technology, Putailai, and BTR New Materials. In lithium battery materials, competitors include Zhongwei Co., Ltd., GEM Co., Ltd., and Huayou Cobalt. In ceramic materials, Guoci Materials is a comparable peer. In strategic resources, Hanrui Cobalt is a major competitor. Dowstone is positioned in the first tier of the industry with strong R&D, production scale, and customer recognition, especially in carbon nanotubes and ternary precursors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 7.75 billion, a 6.25% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 156.86 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in 2023. Overseas sales accounted for about 65.8% of revenue, growing 18.2%. The company has expanded production capacity across all segments and continues to invest in R&D and international market expansion. Total assets were about RMB 14.31 billion at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dowstone emphasizes its integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished products, advanced proprietary technologies in carbon nanotubes and lithium battery precursors, and strong R&D capabilities. Its single-wall carbon nanotube products have high purity and performance, challenging foreign technology monopolies. The company offers differentiated silicon-carbon anode materials and full-material solutions for solid-state batteries. Its ceramic materials are recognized for quality and innovation, with a unique full-category glaze product line. The company’s global customer base and strategic resource control enhance its competitive advantage.
